title: A Fock-space inequality and the Laughlin spectral gap

abstractEnglish: We prove the spherical fermionic Laughlin spectral-gap conjecture for the full V1 interaction. With coefficient one for each pair projector, the gap above the Laughlin state at filling 1/3 on the round sphere is at least 1/25 for all sufficiently large systems. More generally, $`H_Q^2\ge\gamma H_Q`$ for some fixed $`\gamma\gt 1/25`$ on the entire lowest-Landau-level Fock space for all sufficiently large flux Q, independently of particle number.
titleEn: A Fock-space inequality and the Laughlin spectral gap

details.overview: 稿件研究球形费米子Laughlin谱隙猜想，针对完整的V1相互作用。作者声称，在填充因子1/3的Laughlin态之上，对每对投影算子取系数1时，足够大系统的能隙至少为1/25；更一般地，在足够大磁通量Q下，最低Landau能级Fock空间上满足H_Q^2≥γH_Q，其中γ>1/25且与粒子数无关。该结果若成立，将为分数量子霍尔效应中Laughlin态的稳定性提供严格数学依据。
keyPoints: 证明球形费米子Laughlin谱隙猜想，能隙下界为1/25
